record.paper_title: Some of my favorite open problems
record.original_question: For the nonlocal functionals lambda Phi_{lambda,p} associated with the pairwise threshold |u(x)-u(y)|^p / |x-y|^{p+N}, do these functionals Gamma-converge as lambda -> infinity to a local Sobolev/BV functional: c_p ||grad u||_{L^p}^p for u in W^{1,p}(Omega), infinity otherwise when p>1, and c_1 ||grad u||_M for u in BV(Omega), infinity otherwise when p=1, for some positive constants c_p and c_1?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 9.3 ([32, Section 7.3]). Does the family of functionals lambda Phi_{lambda,p} converge as lambda -> infinity, in the sense of Gamma-convergence, to the functional Psi?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Omega \subset \mathbb{R}^N$ be a bounded smooth domain and fix $p \geq 1$. For a measurable function $u:\Omega \to \mathbb{R}$ and $\lambda > 0$, define the nonlocal threshold-type functional
$$\Phi_{\lambda,p}(u) \;=\; \iint_{\{(x,y)\in\Omega\times\Omega \,:\, |u(x)-u(y)|>\lambda\}} \frac{\lambda^{p}}{|x-y|^{p+N}}\,dx\,dy,$$
or, equivalently up to the convention used here, the family of functionals built from the pairwise "threshold" density
$$\frac{|u(x)-u(y)|^p}{|x-y|^{p+N}}\,\mathbf{1}_{\{|u(x)-u(y)|>\lambda\}},$$
and consider the rescaled family $\lambda\,\Phi_{\lambda,p}$ on $L^1(\Omega)$ (or $L^p(\Omega)$).

Define the candidate limit functional $\Psi_p:L^1(\Omega)\to [0,\infty]$ by:
- if $p>1$:
$$\Psi_p(u) \;=\; \begin{cases} c_p \displaystyle\int_\Omega |\nabla u(x)|^p\,dx & \text{if } u\in W^{1,p}(\Omega),\\ +\infty & \text{otherwise};\end{cases}$$
- if $p=1$:
$$\Psi_1(u) \;=\; \begin{cases} c_1\, |Du|(\Omega) & \text{if } u\in BV(\Omega),\\ +\infty & \text{otherwise};\end{cases}$$
where $c_p, c_1 > 0$ are appropriate positive constants depending only on $p$ and $N$.

Question: Does the family $\lambda\,\Phi_{\lambda,p}$ $\Gamma$-converge, as $\lambda \to \infty$, to the functional $\Psi_p$, with respect to the $L^1(\Omega)$ topology? More precisely, prove or disprove that there exist positive constants $c_p$ (for $p>1$) and $c_1$ (for $p=1$) such that:
1. (liminf inequality) For every sequence $u_\lambda \to u$ in $L^1(\Omega)$, $\liminf_{\lambda\to\infty} \lambda\,\Phi_{\lambda,p}(u_\lambda) \geq \Psi_p(u)$.
2. (recovery sequence) For every $u\in L^1(\Omega)$, there exists $u_\lambda \to u$ in $L^1(\Omega)$ with $\limsup_{\lambda\to\infty}\lambda\,\Phi_{\lambda,p}(u_\lambda) \leq \Psi_p(u)$.
artifact.status_search_result: Recent surveys and papers on Brezis–Nguyen-type nonlocal characterizations of Sobolev and BV norms (e.g., Nguyen's 2025 survey on arXiv) continue to discuss pointwise/integral convergence and inequalities for these threshold functionals but do not announce a resolution of the Γ-convergence statement to c_p‖∇u‖_p^p (or c_1|Du| in the BV case). No source found establishing or refuting the Γ-convergence as λ → ∞; the problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Characterizations of the Sobolev norms and the total variation via nonlocal functionals, and related problems
status_evidence.snippet: Survey on Brezis–Nguyen nonlocal functionals characterizing Sobolev/BV norms, listing related open problems and new results, without resolving the Γ-convergence question for λΦ_{λ,p}.
status_evidence.claim: Recent survey continues to treat the Γ-convergence of these threshold functionals as an unresolved direction.

status_evidence.title: Non-local Functionals Related to the Total Variation and Connections with Image Processing
status_evidence.snippet: Studies pointwise and integral convergence of nonlocal threshold functionals to multiples of the BV/Sobolev norms; Γ-convergence not established in full generality.
status_evidence.claim: Convergence results known in weak senses but Γ-convergence statement remains a separate, open question.
